did.unittitle: Collection of children's bookplates

corpname.part: Robert B. Haas Family Arts Library Special Collections

descriptivenote.p: Materials are in English and German with a few materials in other languages such as Catalan, Dutch, Hungarian, and Latin.

did.abstract: Collection of bookplates for and about children including 166 prints and 8 proofs and one original drawing. The collection contains American, English, and German plates featuring engravings, etchings, letterpress and offset printing, dating from 1854 to 1940, for individuals and institutions.

scopecontent.head: Scope and Contents
scopecontent.p: Collection of bookplates for and about children including 166 prints and 8 proofs and one original drawing. The collection contains American, English, and German plates featuring engravings, etchings, letterpress and offset printing, dating from 1854 to 1940, for individuals and institutions.

custodhist.head: Custodial History
custodhist.p: This collection was originally stewarded by the Robert B. Haas Family Arts Library at Yale Library. In July 2026, the collection's stewardship was transferred to Beinecke Rare Book and Manuscript Library.

acqinfo.head: Immediate Source of Acquisition
acqinfo.p: Purchased from Thomas G. Boss Fine Books, 2025.

scopecontent.p: Pictorial bookplate, inscribed: "Ex Libris \ Wolfgang Erfurth." Depicts a putto holding a basket of flowers. Signed by artist below plate line.

did.unittitle: Bookplate of Jessie Clover

scopecontent.head: Scope and Contents
scopecontent.p: Pictorial bookplate depicting a girl wearing a flowing garment and sitting on the floor in front of a bookcase with a doll next to her. Artist's initials, "I.B.W.", visible in bottom-right corner of image. "England" written in pencil on reverse.

did.unittitle: Bookplate of Paul Nic. Ratajczak, designed by Ernst Horstmeyer

scopecontent.head: Scope and Contents
scopecontent.p: Pictorial bookplate, inscribed: "Semper Avanti! \ Aus der Buechersammlung des Paul Nic. Ratajczak, Berlin." Depicts a curtain being pulled back between Corinthian columns to show two children reading in a library while a third climbs a ladder to get a book off a high shelf. "Horstmeyer entworfen" visible in bottom-left corner. "[illegible] Berlin" written in pencil and "Sammlung Albert Ross" stamped on reverse.

did.unittitle: Bookplate of Niels P. Thomsen, designed by Alfred Soder

scopecontent.head: Scope and Contents
scopecontent.p: Pictorial bookplate, inscribed: "ex- Libris \ Niels P. Thomsen." Depicts an open book on the ground below three children holding a platter of flowers over their heads with birds and butterflies hovering above. Artist's name and date visible along bottom edge of open book pages. "[illegible] Alfred Soder, Basel" written in pencil on reverse.

did.unittitle: Bookplate of Agnes Richardson

scopecontent.head: Scope and Contents
scopecontent.p: Pictorial bookplate, inscribed: "'He who does this Book borrow \ and does not give it back \ of certes shall he have sorrow \ and comfort shall he lack.' \ Ex Libris Agnes Richardson." Depicts two cherubs holding ribbons hanging a heart bearing inscription. Possible artist's initials visible in lower-left corner of floral border.

scopecontent.head: Scope and Contents
scopecontent.p: Inscribed: "My Book." Watercolor drawing and hand lettering with dashed lines below text at the bottom of the page.
